title: negundo sessilifolium
intro: Negundo sessilifolium, commonly known as Horse Chestnut Tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Sapindaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of varicose veins, inflammation, and pain relief due to its anti-inflammatory and anticoagulant properties. The therapeutic actions of Negundo sessilifolium include reducing swelling, improving circulation, and acting as an analgesic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
